meta.notes: Foreword tutorial: look-around, binos, two laser hits 300+ m apart. No fire mission (guns cold).

tlog.msg: CHAPTER F.1 — EYES BEFORE GUNS (NORMAL). Training target: a derelict landing craft on the beach, grid bearing ~1600 mils. It cannot shoot back. Neither could the last observer.
MET: wind from 1300 mils at 2 m/s — read your smoke; it will drift downwind. Rounds are not wind-corrected on this net (the FDC applies met).

Your OP: watchtower at grid 245 554, ground elev 262 m, deck +300 m. Use [B] binos and [L] laser to fix the target ([M] map, [K] mission menu), then send your call for fire — grid, polar, or shift from a known point. Hold [SPACE] to transmit by voice, or type below.

NAVIGATION: your heading readout is MAGNETIC. The grid, the map sheet and the fire net are GRID. Declination is 7° EAST, so GRID = MAG + 124 mils. Send OT DIRECTION in GRID — [R] has the conversion on the mil card, and the sheet carries the declination diagram.

Known points registered: AB1001 "CHAPEL" grid 235 555 (grid brg 4853) · AB1002 "DERBY" grid 256 558 (grid brg 1225). Shift example: "adjust fire, shift known point 1001, right 200, add 400, over" — the KP name works too ("shift BREWERY").

NO-STRIKE: civilian villages HIKE and MOVA and FAVANGO — plotted on your map sheet. Collateral damage fails the mission, same as fratricide. Permanent structures and roads are on the sheet too — use them to orient.
>>> THE JOB: Training target: a derelict landing craft on the beach, grid bearing ~1600 mils. It cannot shoot back. Neither could the last observer.
NORTH OF GRAVEYARD, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT
This net has seen career-enders, mercy kills, and one observer who called fire on his own foxhole by accident. Let us find out which one you are, over.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: First lesson is free: LOOK AROUND. Drag your eyes across the whole horizon — mouse or stick. The heading readout up top is in mils, 6400 to a circle. Go.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: Adequate. Now glass up — press [B]. The reticle is graduated in mils; you will measure the world with it.
MUSTANG 12, HELLHOUND FIRES — I HAVE A SPOT REPORT FOR YOU, RELAYED FROM THE OBSERVER YOU RELIEVED, WHO IS NOW ASLEEP. SALUTE FORMAT. STAND BY, OVER.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: Now LASE — put the reticle on any piece of this island and press [L]. Range and grid come straight back. That laser is worth more than you are.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: Again — a DIFFERENT spot, three hundred meters or more from the first. An observer confirms. He does not assume.
SIZE: ONE DERELICT LANDING CRAFT. ACTIVITY: STATIC. ABANDONED. DEEPLY UNTHREATENING. LOCATION: NORTH OF GRAVEYARD, WITHIN TWO THOUSAND METRES OF IT, OVER.
GUNNY BOTTLECAP: Eyes, glass, laser. That is the whole instrument. Tomorrow we find out if the brain is attached.
UNIT: IRREGULARS. THEY ARE NOT WEARING ANYBODY'S UNIFORM. TIME: 15 MINUTES OLD. EQUIPMENT: NONE. IT IS SCRAP, AND IT IS YOURS. OVER.
That report has been passed through four radios and two liars. Verify it yourself.
